title: Datasets
text: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) summary statistics across US census tracts, measuring market concentration different vehicle market dimensions. HHI values computed per census tract based dealers reachable within 60-minute drive time isochrone, summarized across tracts. Higher HHI values indicate greater market concentration (less diversity). Nine grouping-variable combinations included: grouping variable (powertrain, vehicle type, price bin), HHI computed three variables (make, two remaining grouping variables). Census-tract-level HHI values (summarization) also available parquet files GitHub.

title: Datasets
text: Local market share summary statistics across US census tracts, measuring distribution share vehicle listings (p) different vehicle market segments. Values computed per census tract based dealers reachable within 60-minute drive time isochrone, summarized across tracts. Three grouping variables included: powertrain, vehicle type, price bin. Census-tract-level values (summarization) also available parquet files GitHub.
